title: ADU shed roof assembly (LOD 400 + BOM): framing, deck, standing seam, trim, insulation
intent: Replace a placeholder shed roof with a real build-up and turn it into one roof assembly: 2x8 rafters @ 24in, pony wall on the high side, raked end infill, frieze blocks, outlookers and fly rafters, 3/4in plywood deck, standing seam roofing, 1x10 fascia and barge boards covering every exposed rafter cut, batts and drywall inside the wall lines, shop drawing and BOM with cost.

sequence.do: Read the roof as modelled before planning: type, slope, footprint, overhangs, height gap between flat wall plates and the sloped roof underside, neighbouring elements (e.g. a trellis under the eave)

Ask the decisions that belong to the user: structure (rafters + pony wall vs trusses), member size (engineer flag), roofing for the slope (5 deg excludes asphalt shingles), overhangs, trim, soffit, insulation, assembly grouping
2D preview from the layout rule: framing plan, sheathing plan, section; check every view direction; look at the exported images

Replace the placeholder roof: new footprint roof with the real layers (Revit 2024 cannot edit roof sketches or attach walls by API), user re-attaches the walls, then delete the old roof; guard every transaction
Component families: lumber types 2x8 / 2x4 flat; work-plane-based copies of sheet and insulation families; flex-test the plane orientation

Build from one layout rule in a dry run with an all-pairs clash check; offset square-cut ends by depth x sin(slope); commit only with allow-listed contacts; trim must cover every exposed cut; insulation only inside the exterior wall lines
Create the assembly after Regenerate; name it after commit
BOM from the model: check every piece against its stock size; reset Cost and Type Comments on duplicated types; price with source and date; stock conversion, waste, tax, range
Shop drawing: framing plan with deck hidden, deck layout, section along the slope, 3D, parts list, dimensions one per transaction, BOM note; export and look at the sheet

rules_from_the_owner: Insulation only inside the exterior wall lines; overhangs (eaves and rakes) are not insulated
Exposed rafter and fly-rafter cuts are covered by fascia and barge boards
Choose the cheapest build that meets the requirements, and flag what the engineer must confirm
The wedge under the roof is treated like the rest of the exterior wall (insulation, sheathing, siding, gypsum)
discipline_authority: Structural engineer: rafter size, hurricane ties, pony wall bracing, header under the pony wall, trellis connection
Energy code: R-value of the roof insulation

intended_contacts: batts compressed under outlookers in the two end bays
